entries.title: Gitmejsen
entries.alt: Gitmejsen sidder på en grankvist med sit koboltblå tørklæde, spidse plettede fjertop og en lille messingklemme ved siden af sig.
entries.prompt: Godkendt 3D-portræt af topmejsen med blåt tørklæde og grankvist. Gitmejsens akvarelportræt bestemmer figuren, og Kamæleonens portræt er reference for dybde, lys og materialer.

entries.title: På vintergrenen
entries.alt: Gitmejsen har pustet fjerene op og sidder med sit blå tørklæde på en snepudret grankvist.
entries.prompt: Make one square full-body character portrait of the same bird, nestled in her signature cobalt scarf at first snow. Use reference image as the exact identity of the original female crested tit teacher. Preserve her tall tapered black-speckled cream feather crest, curved dark cheek marking, cream belly, small dark bib and short pointed bill, taupe wings, gentle expressive amber-brown eyes, two natural bird feet, and her one signature woven cobalt-blue scarf with exactly two short ends at its knot. She is a proper bird throughout with two wings, two tiny clawed feet, no hands, no human arms or additional limbs. Same softly sculpted matte, tactile, subtly stylized Nordic 3D stop-motion storybook render, natural scale, warm materials. No logos, text, labels, signatures or fake typography. Winter variant: slightly fluffed down, a few snow crystals on the upper bark of the short spruce twig and a softly falling dusting around her. She wears a very small pale tan knitted earwarmer band lower around the back of her head beneath the crest if it can fit naturally; the classic clear pointed crest remains entirely visible; keep the costume restrained. Quiet winter wonder and warm diffuse daylight. Pale warm ivory through cold blue paper-like studio ground, no forest clutter, full unclipped bird and branch with space around them.

entries.title: Arkivaren
entries.alt: Gitmejsen med blåt tørklæde og runde messingbriller undersøger en ring på sin siddegren.
entries.prompt: One square full-body studio character portrait of the same bird in her archive outfit. Use reference image as the exact identity of the original female crested tit teacher. Preserve her tall tapered black-speckled cream feather crest, curved dark cheek marking, cream belly, small dark bib and short pointed bill, taupe wings, gentle expressive amber-brown eyes, two natural bird feet, and her one signature woven cobalt-blue scarf with exactly two short ends at its knot. She is a proper bird throughout with two wings, two tiny clawed feet, no hands, no human arms or additional limbs. Same softly sculpted matte, tactile, subtly stylized Nordic 3D stop-motion storybook render, natural scale, warm materials. No logos, text, labels, signatures or fake typography. She adds tiny antique round brass spectacles perched plausibly on her upper beak, with her amber eyes readable, and wears her cobalt neck scarf. She tilts her head inquisitively toward a single small brass ring-tag affixed to the end of a birch twig used as her perch. Clean character silhouette, softly sculpted feathers and tactile blue wool; spare warm ivory backdrop, affinity to Finnish storybooks, no extra objects. Full body, twig, crest and feet within the frame.
